text:
Haris Malik: Hey team, hi! I'm Haris — joining Developer Experience today. Excited to get started. Quick setup Qs: who do I ping for MDM enrollment and laptop VPN? Also who is my onboarding buddy? PS: allergic to peanuts, jealous of your sticker collections :grimacing:. Fun fact: I do midnight pottery and have a tiny collection of vintage train tickets.

onboard-bot: Welcome Haris :tada: — we've created your account. Please follow the checklist: https://redwood.internal/onboard/checklist and enroll in MDM here: https://redwood.internal/it/mdm. If you hit issues, reply here and tag @marta-it.

Ava Chen: Welcome Haris!! I'm your buddy for the first month — calendar invite sent for a 30m sync tomorrow 10am PT. I'll add you to #devex-buddies. For quick access, here's the VPN client config link: https://redwood.internal/it/vpn — follow step 2 for the new profile.

Marta Li (IT): Hey Haris — pinged. If your laptop hasn't arrived, open a hardware ticket: https://redwood.internal/it/tickets/new. MDM steps are: 1) open the enroll link, 2) accept SSO, 3) install CompanyPortal. If you prefer, we can screen-share — drop preferred times.

Sam Wells: FYI infra access needs one more step for the jump host. Haris, run: 
```bash
ssh-copy-id -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub haris@jump.redwood.internal
```
Then ping me and I'll add the infra team ACL. Also sticker pack incoming :stickers:.

Priya Rao: Welcome! Add yourself to #devex and #dev-platform. Standup is 9:30am PT. Also ping me when you're comfortable and I can walk you through the local eval harness — it's small but has a quirky setup script.

Haris Malik: Thanks everyone — joining #devex now. Laptop is scheduled to arrive today per the tracking link. I'll try the SSH step and post here if I hit errors. Appreciate the buddy setup @Ava Chen, see you tomorrow. 

Ava Chen: Great! Bringing snacks for the sync? (jk but also not) :coffee:

Haris Malik: I'll bring a photo of my train tickets instead :railway_track: — thanks all, will report back after enrollment attempts.

Marta Li (IT): If you get an MDM error about certificates, run: 
```bash
sudo security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain ~/Downloads/redwood-ca.pem
```
and then re-run the installer. LMK the exact error if it persists.

Haris Malik: Got the cert step working, enrolled successfully. Thanks Marta! :raised_hands:

onboard-bot: Haris has completed MDM enrollment. Remember to complete HR forms: https://redwood.internal/hr/forms.

Sam Wells: ACL applied, you should have jump access now — let me know if `ssh` hangs.

Haris Malik: Can confirm SSH works. Thanks everyone for the warm welcome :blush: — excited to be here!
